Definition: from G5355; to be jealous of:--envy.
BiblicalUsage: Phthoneo means to envy, to begrudge another what they have. Paul names it once, in Galatians 5:26, as the fruit of vain glory: provoking one another, envying one another.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that envy is not admiration gone wrong, it is love gone cold toward a brother.
